steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Human language has unique features (Hockett's design features): semanticity (words have meaning), generativity (can create infinite new sentences), displacement (can talk about past/future/abstract), arbitrariness (no connection between word and referent), and cultural transmission (learned from others). | Key Fact: Animal communication: bees use waggle dances to communicate food location (shows displacement and semanticity but not generativity). Vervet monkeys use distinct alarm calls for different predators (shows semanticity but limited generativity). Birdsongs are largely innate with some learned elements. | Key Fact: Washoe the chimp: taught over 100 signs in ASL, combined signs creatively (e.g. 'water bird' for swan).
